name: my-fe-standards
description: AI 辅助开发平台 - 前端架构师规则库 + Ralph 自主编码系统

scripts.build:bundle:validators: esbuild scripts/src/rule-validator.ts scripts/src/skill-validator.ts scripts/src/repo-state-validator.ts scripts/src/contract-validator.ts scripts/src/agent-registry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outdir=scripts/dist
scripts.build:bundle:analysis: esbuild scripts/src/structure-analyzer.ts scripts/src/module-mapper.ts scripts/src/report-manager.ts scripts/src/reference-finder.ts scripts/src/context-collector.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outdir=scripts/dist
scripts.build:bundle: npm run build:bundle:loader && npm run build:bundle:validators && npm run build:bundle:analysis && npm run build:bundle:orchestrator
scripts.build: npm run build:scripts && npm run build:bundle && npm run build:manifest
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run build:release:collect
scripts.gate:quick: npm run build && npm run test:lib && npm run validate:all
scripts.gate:release: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:full && npm run validate:all:strict && node scripts/dist/validator-gate.js run --strict --scope all --json && node scripts/dist/report-manager.js audit --json
scripts.ci:correctness: npm run test:lib && npm run build:mcp-server && npm run test:correctness
scripts.ci:full: npm run build && npm run build:mcp-server && npm run test:full
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:repo && npm run validate:rules && npm run validate:skills
scripts.validate:all:strict: npm run validate:repo:strict && npm run validate:rules:strict && npm run validate:skills:strict
scripts.test: npm run test:lib && npm run test:correctness
